    How it works

    Mixer

    • Pick a brand and a range on the left. Click a paint to put it into the active layer. Star a brand to keep it on top.
    • Each part has up to eight layers. Set the role with the button in front of the paint.
    • Add layer inserts below the active one. Drag a layer by its number, or press Alt + arrow keys, to move it. A removed layer comes back with Undo.
    • ≈ shows similar paints from other ranges. Point at one to see it on the shape, click to swap it in.
    • The part tabs show the paints of each part. Part renames, duplicates, moves, copies, clears or deletes the open part. Each part has a note below its layers.
    • Click the scheme name to switch schemes or start a new one.

    Preview

    • Drag on the shape to move the light. Double-click resets it.
    • Sphere, cylinder, cone, block or cloth. Smooth blends the layers, Stepped shows each layer as a band.
    • sets the light strength, double-click puts it back to the middle. The arrow button enlarges the preview.
    • Primer is not drawn. A shade or wash darkens the layer before it.

    Schemes

    • A scheme holds all parts of a model, each with its layers. Imperial Fists and Death Guard are examples; change or delete them as you like.
    • One card per part. Open in Mixer lets you change its paints. Back in the browser returns to the scheme.
    • Click the name of a scheme or a part to rename it (in the Mixer: double-click a part tab).
    • Paints needed lists every paint of the scheme by brand. Once you have marked your paints, Missing shows only what you still need, and Copy missing paints gives you a shopping list.
    • Copy puts the whole scheme on the clipboard as text. The scheme menu ⋯ renames, duplicates, saves to a file or deletes it.

    Paints

    • Mark the paints you own: click, drag across, or click a row name. Owned paints get a dot in the chart.
    • Mine shows only your paints.
    • Everything is saved in this browser as you go. Save writes your paints and schemes to a file, Load reads it back. Save as picks a new file. Keep a file as a backup.
    • Settings at the top right also has Save and Load, plus Clear all: it deletes everything and starts over with the example schemes.

    Keyboard

    • / or Ctrl + K jumps to the search. Arrow keys and Enter open a paint in its range. Shift + Enter puts the paint into the active layer.
    • Alt + 1, 2, 3 switch between Mixer, Schemes and Paints.
    • A adds a layer, Delete removes the active one, R changes its role.
    • In the layers, up and down pick a layer, left and right reach its role, ≈ and ×.
    • On a part tab: left and right switch parts, F2 renames, Delete deletes the part.
    • Arrow keys move through the brand list, F stars a brand, Alt + arrows reorders stars.
    • Arrow keys on the shape move the light.
    • Enter on a row name marks the whole row in Paints.
